marketing_wrapper: Near-black purple (#1d1a23) backdrop, white two-line caption in the top ~17%, a silver-bezel iPhone (~75%). Marketing pop-outs overlap the frame: an enlarged 'Calories left' card (01), food-label bubbles (03), and coloured Protein/Carbs/Fats pills (04). The screens underneath are real-looking UI: home dashboard, scanner, nutrition result, analytics. None of the quiz/paywall funnel that defines the app is shown.

typography.display: Geometric grotesque in semibold/bold for the big calorie number (1250) and titles; resembles Manrope or a similar geometric sans (also used in captions), unsure
typography.body: custom geometric sans (unsure which), not SF
typography.numerals: proportional, large bold hero number; small bold macro grams (45g, 89g); chart axis numbers regular; not tabular
typography.weights: Bold numbers and card titles, regular grey labels (Calories left, Carbs left)
typography.case_and_tracking: Sentence case; units glued to numbers (67Kg, 93g); default tracking

palette.accent_strategy: Semantic per macro: coral-red protein, orange carbs, blue fats (rings, icons, stacked bars) plus green for a positive trend and health score; black is the action colour (FAB, Done, segment selection). A faint pink-lavender haze tints the top of each screen.
palette.source: palette.json 01–04: #1d1a23 ~50% = marketing backdrop (also matches the black FAB/Done button); #fefdfe / #ffffff 26–36% = app background; #aba6a1 / #b3a9ac = device bezel; #b0a38c / #39342c in 02 = food photo. Macro hexes are visual estimates.

shape.radius_language: large: ~16pt cards and tiles, pill segmented controls, pill Done/Fix Results buttons, circular FAB and progress rings, ~12pt photo corners in meal rows
shape.borders_shadows: Very light grey card fills with faint borders; soft shadow on the floating FAB; marketing pop-outs have bigger shadows
shape.materials: Flat; translucent dark circles over the camera image; a white pill tool tray over the viewfinder

density: medium-high: hero card, three macro ring tiles in a row, then meal rows with photo + 5 data points each; analytics stacks two segmented controls and two charts
layout: Home: logo + bell, Today/Yesterday text tabs, a hero 'calories left' card with a ring, a paged row of three macro ring cards, then 'Recently uploaded' meal rows (photo left, name/time/kcal/macros right), floating black + FAB.
navigation: Bottom tab bar with 3 labelled tabs (Home, Analytics, Settings), SF-like outline icons, plus a detached black circular + FAB; camera has circular back/overflow buttons and a mode tray (Scan food, barcode, gallery, label, edit).
imagery_and_icons: Stock-style food photography; small filled colour glyphs for macros (drumstick, wheat, water drop, flame); outline tab icons; a sparkle glyph on 'Fix Results'.
signature_visual_move: A black-arc calorie ring beside a huge bold number, followed by three colour-coded macro rings — the standard fitness-dashboard grammar.
tells_present: Per-screen drift (tab bar in 04 shows an extra gear where the FAB sits in 01)

direction_fit.why: The visible UI is a competent but generic ring-and-card dashboard with no ownable visual idea; the identity is the conversion funnel, which the screenshots don't show. Nothing here argues for a dealable direction.

notes: Analytics weight axis is inverted (60Kg at top, 80Kg at bottom) and the heading reads 'Nutritions' — small craft slips. Sparkle on 'Fix Results' is labelled, so the unlabelled-sparkle tell does not apply.
